text:
jess: CI red on runtime unit test suite: TestServeRetryOrdering flaky on linux/amd64 in nightly - build 8421. Seen 3 times in last 24h. Anyone on this? https://ci.example.com/build/8421
ryan: I'll grab a quick look. Can you paste failing output?
jess: pasted below:
```
FAIL runtime/serve_test.go:123: TestServeRetryOrdering
--- FAIL: TestServeRetryOrdering (0.15s)
    serve_test.go:158: expected X got Y
    stack: goroutine 45 [running]: ...
```
Also repro seems to only fail with -race off.
sam: Saw similar yesterday on mac builders. Might be timing-sensitive. Does rerunning help?
jess: Rerun didn't help: `/rerun 8421` -> still red. I can run locally but need a way to capture trace/pprof when it flakes.
ci-bot: Job 8421 started by jess — logs: https://ci.example.com/build/8421/logs
ryan: If you can run with `TEST_SEED=52341 go test ./runtime -run TestServeRetryOrdering -v` and then `GOTRACEBACK=all` let's capture stack. Also enable `-count=20` to stress. Can you try and upload the failing archived test binary + logs to /tmp/artifacts and drop link?
jess: On it. Running now with `GODEBUG=scheddetail=1` jk. Will push artifacts to s3://redwood-ci-artifacts/jess/8421-flake.tar.gz when done.
sam: If it reproduces locally, could you run with the patch I mentioned earlier? /cc @oncall-runtime in case we want to hold the nightly.
oncall-runtime: Holding nightlies for 30m, will pause new runs. Also can enable verbose scheduler logs for this job.
jess: Repro succeeded locally once. Uploading: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-ci/jess/8421-flake.tar.gz. It contains logs, `go test -run` command, and full core dump.
ryan: Thanks—I'll start bisecting on seeds and add `time.Sleep(1ms)` tweaks to narrow. If anyone has quick ideas: check for shared global state in serve.go; maybe race between session TTL and retry handler.
sam: :thumbsup: let me know if you want me to bisect across OS matrix.
jess: Appreciate it. Will update thread with any new reproductions. tagging PR #4156 which may be related.
